projects.name: ChatGPU
projects.overview: Distributed compute workspace that plans uploaded Python jobs, assigns compatible workers, validates outputs and preserves execution history.

individual_scope.confidence: high: authored commits and changed files
facts: Created orchestration prototype; Supabase authentication and private worker gateway; bundled Tailscale enrollment.
Built fleet assistant with separate model adapter and durable tool loop; added job supervisors, execution history and telemetry integration.

Added agent-planned simulation uploads, CAD usage estimates and soft caps, persistent HTTP service hosting, automatic dependency setup for uploaded Python/PyTorch jobs, verified GPU worker execution and parallel advisory analysis agents.
Authored native training preparation and CUDA/HIP migration loop in OPEN PR #25; not merged into main.

implementation_evidence: backend/src/orchestrator/agent/loop.py: model-call/tool-call budget, saved caller-owned history, interruption handling, duplicate IDs, 8-step/90-second default limit.
backend/src/orchestrator/preprocessing/analysis.py: maximum 3 concurrent advisory analysis agents, maximum 6 child calls.
backend/src/orchestrator/supervisor/tools.py: constrained recovery actions; retry cannot increase max_attempts or edit payloads; reservations bounded to four workers/five minutes.
backend/src/orchestrator/worker/executors/python_project.py: uploaded projects executed on assigned device, input bundles, preparation/execution handling.
Repository README: PostgreSQL lease/result state, outbound connections, compatible worker selection, 5-second heartbeat and 45-second lease configuration.

metrics.value: 3 concurrent analysis agents; 6 child calls/job; 8 steps and 90 seconds/assistant turn
metrics.classification: configured bounds observed in code, not throughput measurements

metrics.value: A5000 5.91x and L40S 6.69x accepted; MI300X 4.58x rejected with 13/300 changed answers
metrics.classification: README-reported, recorded GPUShare experiment evidence from separate work; NOT independently rerun, NOT whole-training or end-to-end ChatGPU speedups

boundaries: Main supports Python/PyTorch, one program on one worker, process isolation without a security sandbox.
Main workers verify CPU/CUDA/Apple MPS. GPUShare and migration work live on separate branches; README says no original RTX 4090 migration passed the 300-case check.
PR #25 is open. Scope is native AXPY training pilot, not arbitrary program optimization; synthetic test reports only, live CUDA/HIP validation still pending.
Main README explicitly excludes GPU rental, marketplace, job splitting across machines and automatic deployment/rollback. Soft CAD caps are estimates; no payment processing.
Screenshot demo used two CPU workers, with model key absent; do not treat screenshots as proof of live LLM/GPU end-to-end success.
45 qiuethan main-branch contributor commits is a provenance signal, not a productivity metric; include team work explicitly.
draft_bullets: Built the orchestration layer for ChatGPU, turning uploaded Python projects into planned, validated jobs across CPU, CUDA and Apple MPS workers.
Implemented durable agent supervision, worker recovery, execution history and Sentry diagnostics, with bounded tool actions and per-run usage caps.
Co-built the Hack the North 2026 winner for Best Use of Sentry.
projects.in_flight_bullet: Developed an unmerged native training optimization and CUDA/HIP migration loop with fixed correctness checks, benchmark-based acceptance and restart recovery; live cross-vendor validation remains pending.
projects.evidence_quality: Source code and authored commits verify implementation/provenance; Devpost verifies team descriptions and prize badges. No project was run, benchmarked or deployed during this research.
